findings.title: FirstLaunch handoff never publishes the existing Match route
findings.reproduction: Clear app data; choose English and Full guidance; complete FirstLaunch; observe the loading cover indefinitely; cold restart and observe ResumeHandoff with the same cover.
findings.cause: FirstLaunchNarrativeShellCompositionSystemHelper persisted EnterMission/HandoffPending without adding the existing UiShellRouteIntent.EnterMatch request, so the existing Match lifecycle owner never loaded the Match world.
findings.response: Publish exactly one existing EnterMatch/Match route request from the existing handoff boundary, guarded by handoffPublished.
findings.closureRequires: Fresh exact-head APK install and successful Samsung FirstLaunch-to-M01 replay
